slot.brief: Sum an arithmetico-geometric series to n terms by multiplying by the common ratio and subtracting.

stem: The sum of the first $n$ terms of $3+\dfrac{5}{3}+\dfrac{7}{3^2}+\cdots$ is

verdicts.working: The kth term is (2k+1)/3^(k−1). Summing this arithmetic-geometric series gives S_n = 6 − (n+2)/3^(n−1), matching option B.

working:
Let $S_n=3+\dfrac{5}{3}+\cdots+\dfrac{2n+1}{3^{n-1}}$. Then
$\dfrac{2}{3}S_n=3+2\left(\dfrac13+\cdots+\dfrac1{3^{n-1}}\right)-\dfrac{2n+1}{3^n}$
$=3+\left(1-\dfrac1{3^{n-1}}\right)-\dfrac{2n+1}{3^n}$
$S_n=6-\dfrac{n+2}{3^{n-1}}$.

Independent check: The kth term is (2k+1)/3^(k−1). Summing this arithmetic-geometric series gives S_n = 6 − (n+2)/3^(n−1), matching option B.
